spans.s: लौलाह लौलाह, N. of a place.

लौल्य लौल्य, अम्, n. (fr. लोल), restlessness,
instability, inconstancy, fickleness; lustfulness, eager-
ness, eager desire, greediness, passion, (अ-लौल्य,
अम्, n. absence of all desire.)
—लौल्य-ता, f. lustful-
ness, eager desire.
—लौल्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, eagerly
desirous, eager, greedy, avaricious, lustful.
